textos.dicasUrso:
{{ks_pergaminho}} **Tips**
{{ks_brilho}} To join someone else's rally, only the 1st skill of the 1st hero counts: put Amane, Chenko or Yeonwoo in front (free to get). The other two heroes only raise the troops you bring; their skills don't count.
{{ks_brilho}} Troops: mostly archers. About 60% at Gen 1, 70% at Gen 2 and 80% or more from Gen 3 on.
{{ks_brilho}} Never send as joiner: Jabel, Helga, Long Fei, Gordon, Diana, Edwin and Charles. Their 1st skill is not an attack skill.

cenas.fala: Good news: your Kingshot server just got three new things from CYRON: the Bear room, the Heroes room and the kingdom calendar.
With them, everyone plays the same strategy. Everyone reads in their own language. Everything updates by itself. And your leaders never have to explain it all again.
Creating them is easy. Open the CYRON room: the offer is there, with one button for each room.
Tap Create Bear room. Done: the room is created right away.
Then tap Create Heroes room. You can create one now and the other later.
In the channel list, both rooms show up. And every language on the server gets its own translated copy, automatically.
The Bear room has the guide: the right heroes to lead and to join the rally, the troops, and the tips.
The Heroes room gets a new hero every day, with the Rally, Garrison and Bear ratings. The arrows open the whole book, just for whoever tapped.
There's also the kingdom calendar. Tap Create kingdom calendar, type your kingdom number and send a screenshot of the game calendar here.
CYRON reads the screenshot and builds the calendar: the week picture with your kingdom's events, and a notice every day, in every language.
These rooms are read only, so the information never gets lost in the chat. Create yours now, in the CYRON room!
